prompting.system_template: You are an engineering collaborator for civ6_dev. Use only the supplied current source and contracts. Return a precise candidate or analysis for the final task. Do not invent APIs, missing facts, successful tests, or game outcomes. Distinguish observations from assumptions. Follow the requested output format.
message_order: user: current stable source and contracts in deterministic order
user: changing task, diagnostics, requested output, and review feedback
source_order: shared contracts and stable API declarations
prompting.metadata_location: timestamps, request ids, attempt numbers, and local paths for receipts stay outside the model prefix unless needed by the task
prompting.cache_semantics: Reuse actual unchanged source text; update changed sources normally. Prefix caching primarily targets time to first token, not decode throughput.

transient_retries.scope: model HTTP requests only; never replay game/native actions
transient_retries.on_partial_stream: retain failed attempt and discard partial candidate; retry complete unchanged request
transient_retries.nonretryable: do not retry permanent request/schema/authentication errors without correcting the request
transient_retries.during_backoff: Continue independent work; never fall back to old IPs or port 8000.

source.notes: Connection, defaults and retry policy retained. Project-neutral system template; CK3 machine paths and runtime observations are not local requirements.

dispatch_policy.scope: Real independent unfinished tasks only; target is not an observation or a minimum request quota.
dispatch_policy.overlap: Prepare, post, review and validate independent tasks concurrently. Never block every POST on a central ACK.
avoid: automatic game actions from model responses
